message: Ed, sweetie, I read this pitch twice and I still can't find the moment in it. You want the 27.2-point, top-of-the-front-page headline act for a rookie back and a receiver room reclamation project? That's not a trade, that's a heist with a nice cover letter. Justin Jefferson IS the brand this week — Kris already ran the recap, I'm not writing the follow-up where I gave him away. Come back when the return has a name that trends on its own.
